ValidationRule.description: The wholesale visit type must have value for a whole sale visit.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (ISNEW() || ISCHANGED(TPB_WholesaleVisitType__c)) && TPB_VisitType__c = 'Wholesaler' && ISBLANK(TEXT(TPB_WholesaleVisitType__c)) && OR($Profile.Name ='CG Cloud Mobile - TSM', $Profile.Name ='CG Cloud Mobile - RSM', $Profile.Name ='Account Management')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Wholesale Visit Type cannot be blank.
